era_en: Southern and Northern Dynasties (Liu-Song, Qi, Liang)
school: 祖氏家学/南朝算学/大明历学派
historical_significance: 祖暅（456-536），一作祖暅之，字景烁，范阳遒县（今河北涞水）人，祖冲之之子，南北朝著名算学家、天文学家。他以'幂势既同，则积不容异'的等积原理（后称祖暅原理，西方至1635年才由卡瓦列利重新发现，晚1100余年）解决刘徽遗留两百年的球体积问题：从牟合方盖入手，以残差互补法算得方盖体积，进而得出正确的球体积公式，并将圆周率精度无损传导为球率精度。他于504、509、510年三次上书梁朝，使父亲的《大明历》在天监年间颁行，完成跨代遗愿。他监造八尺铜表测日影，测得北极星偏离北天极一度有余，改进漏壶，著《漏刻经》（失传）、《天文录》（仅存残篇）；修补编辑《缀术》，与父共成此书。曾仕梁为太府卿等职；梁魏交战时被扣于北，在驿站倾囊授学于信都芳，使祖氏之学北传。传学于信都芳、毛栖成及子祖皓，成四世算学之家。
historical_significance_en: Zu Geng (456-536), also styled Zu Gengzhi, courtesy name Jingshuo, of Fanyang, son of Zu Chongzhi, was a famed mathematician-astronomer of the Southern Dynasties. With the equi-volume principle 'when the mi (sectional areas) and shi (their heights' postures) are the same, the ji (volumes) cannot differ' — later called Zu Geng's principle, rediscovered in the West by Cavalieri only in 1635, over 1,100 years later — he solved the sphere-volume problem Liu Hui left open for two centuries: starting from the mouhefanggai and using complementary residues he computed its volume, obtained the correct sphere formula, and transferred π's precision losslessly into the sphere-rate. He thrice memorialized the Liang court (504, 509, 510) and had his father's Daming Calendar promulgated in the Tianjian era, fulfilling a cross-generational wish. He cast an eight-chi bronze gnomon, measured that the Pole Star deviates from the celestial pole by more than one degree, improved the water-clock, wrote the lost Leak-Clock Classic and the fragmentary Record of Astronomy, and with his father completed the Zhui shu. An official of Liang (Grand Minister of the Treasury), he was detained in the north during the Liang-Wei war and taught Xin Du Fang all he knew at a post station, spreading Zu learning northward; he also taught Mao Qicheng and his son Zu Hao, founding four generations of mathematicians.
key_works: 缀术（与祖冲之共著，修补编辑）
